g.text: CoWoS packaging wafers consumed, by designer

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: Epoch AI's published figure at this setting — CoWoS advanced packaging consumption by the 4 tracked AI chip

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: designers (NVIDIA, Google, Amazon, AMD) in each quarter, rebuilt from the downloaded CSV. Q1 2024 to Q4 2025, the full

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Components (CC-BY) — quarterly_by_designer.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-components

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI Chip Components methodology; every figure is a Monte Carlo median over 10,000 draws

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: CoWoS is TSMC's chip-on-wafer-on-substrate packaging, which attaches the logic chiplets and HBM stacks onto one substrate. Bars are

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the four tracked designers only. The dashed line is Epoch's published total world supply of the component in that quarter, so the gap

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: between the two is the residual Epoch labels "Other" - charted in full in the share view. Every value is a Monte Carlo median; the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: published 5th-95th percentile range is wide and is charted separately in CHIP-D04. 3 designer rows for Q1 2026 are excluded as

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: partial - that quarter holds only AMD, Amazon, Google and would show a collapse in demand that is missing coverage, not a fall. Chip

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: designers outside the tracked four (Meta, Microsoft, Tesla, Huawei and others) are not in the source at all.
